scheme_name: Disability (Due to Accident or Other Reason) Scheme- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
Applicant must apply within one year of the issuance of the disability certificate.
Applicant must not have previously received benefits under this scheme.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000 for disability up to 50% and up to ₹1,50,000 for disability above 50%.
